scriptDateEntry: Check stay restrictions and dates on Mokaair
scriptBookingEntry: View dates and all booking platforms on Mokaair
openSameTab: Not opened? Continue to {platform} in this tab
operatingNote: These sourced restrictions exclude stays conservatively; they are not a live availability check.
operatingDatesRequired: Enter check-in and check-out dates to check this hotel's stay restrictions. Dates cannot be omitted.
operatingUnavailable: These dates conflict with a recorded hotel restriction. Change dates or choose another hotel.
operatingInvalid: The hotel restrictions could not be validated. Choose another hotel or contact support.
operatingRange: Unavailable nights: {start} to {end} (check-in can resume on {end}).
restrictedPastDates: These dates are in the past. Enter new check-in and check-out dates.
optional: Optional — no dates or guest counts are assumed.
omitDates: Set dates on the booking platform
invalidDates: Enter both valid dates, with check-out after check-in.
pastDates: These dates are in the past. Update them or set dates on the booking platform.
invalidGuests: Enter whole numbers: 1–9 adults and 0–9 children.
disclosure: We may earn a commission through partner links. Confirm the actual price, room and availability on the booking platform.
confirmOccupancy: Room counts and child ages are not sent through this link. Confirm occupancy and ages on the booking platform.
directConditions: Each platform may retain different preferences. Confirm dates and guests after opening it.
quotesNote: These quotes have their own rooms and terms. They are not Stay22 prices and do not guarantee the same rate through the links above.
mapToggle: Find nearby stays on a map
catalogTitle: Reviewed hotels · go straight to booking platforms
catalogNote: Open the exact hotel's platform page without using the map. No room is reserved and your itinerary is unchanged.
noExactLink: No reviewed direct hotel link is available. Nearby searches below are not links to this exact hotel.
errorTitle: The booking platform could not be opened
errorDetail: No booking was made. Retry this handoff, or return to accommodation options and check your dates again.
openElsewhere: If the original tab is still open, adjust dates there. Otherwise return to accommodation options and enter your dates again.
